calibration_note: Camera bounding box derived from 19317 official DAE vertices including scene instances; dimensions independently checked against STEP solids. Uses official standard mounting with no additional clocking; photos taken without J6 rotation are the qualitative assembly reference, not metric calibration. Gripper center and motor offset remain an approximate envelope. Clearance is an engineering margin. Flexible cables and grasped objects are excluded.
